procedure.boundary: Exact brief/plan, full research-v1 artifact and source-map, admitted research-v1 captures, and public primary technical sources only.
procedure.artifact_time_note: Filesystem modification time after the complete critic artifact was written.

source_operations.counting_rule: Only this critic turn direct public HTTP retrievals counted as new public-source operations. Local input/capture reads and copying admitted research-v1 captures are separate; no test/build/feed/validator operation was performed.

procedure.verification_scope: Reviewed pinned GTFS semantics, exact issue-reported pre-fix OTP code, OTP v2.10.0 matcher and caller, PR patch, release ancestry and release tests. No application tests were executed.

native_goal_counters.counter_type: Aggregate native Goal lifecycle counters only; not per-task input/output/reasoning/billing counters.

observations.source: Actual get_goal response after activation; same threadId identity.

native_goal_counters.terminal_observation: Recorded in final response from actual update_goal and get_goal calls after the scientific output was complete.
